description:
About Double

Double makes AI that automates all bookkeeping and accounting work. We're trusted by thousands of accounting firms across the country, including 20+ of the top 100.

 

Our product connects directly to QuickBooks, Xero, Sage, or NetSuite and automates all bookkeeping: transaction categorization, journal entries, accruals, reconciliation, review, and reporting.

 

As a result, teams on Double close their books up to 10 days faster and free their staff to focus on client service.

 

Double has raised $12M in funding, backed by leading tech investors like Y Combinator and founders at top startups like Lattice, Front, Superhuman, Plaid, and more.

 

What You'll Do

You will produce video content that explains Double's vision, promotes our product, and shares customer stories.

  • Make a launch video for each major release, working with the product team before it ships.

  • Produce video case studies with customer firms, from the interview through a written version.

  • Cut long videos into short clips for LinkedIn, YouTube, and email.

  • Write the scripts, case studies, and launch announcements that go with your videos.

  • Manage freelancers when a project needs them.

 

Requirements

  • You have produced videos end to end, from script through shoot and edit, and can show us a portfolio of them.

  • You can make a software product look good on screen: screen recordings, UI animation, motion graphics.

  • You can interview customers on camera.

  • You’ll write the scripts, the written version of each case study, and launch copy, so you need to write well enough to publish without heavy edits.

  • (Nice to have) You’ve explained a technical or financial product before, or you know accounting.

  • (Nice to have) You’re comfortable being on camera.

 

Benefits

  • Competitive pay and equity

  • Unlimited PTO

  • 100% sponsored Health, dental, and vision insurance

  • Monthly health and fitness stipend

  • WFH office stipend

 

Double provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.
